about: Stratbook rows written by a coach, pasted by the user on 22 Oct 2026 as the style bar for strategy notes (aim4 eye's eyeStrategyNotes.js prompt). One row is one strategy, one string per player column; a string repeated in all five is a team-wide note (spawn-based pistol calls). Map and side were read from the callouts (inferred: true), not given. Typos are kept as written.
